identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One Dots character with a continuous short-dense-plush body and simple paired black eyes. No arms, hands, legs, feet, mouth or screen face.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个 Dots 角色，连续短密绒身体与简洁成对黑眼。无手臂、手、腿、脚、嘴或屏幕脸。

semanticByLanguage.en: a low continuous cloud mound with rounded scallops
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 低矮连续、带圆润起伏的云团

semanticByLanguage.en: a continuous cloud mound with three broad lower lobes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 下缘呈三个宽圆起伏的连续云团

semanticByLanguage.en: two glossy black vertical oval eyes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两枚有高光的黑色竖椭圆眼

semanticByLanguage.en: two black closed-eye arcs, a static expression
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两道黑色闭眼弧线，静态表情

semanticByLanguage.en: an ivory rib-knit sleeveless wrap fitted to the lower body
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 贴合身体下部的象牙白罗纹无袖针织包覆
贴合头顶的黑色毛呢贝雷帽

messageByLanguage.en: This wrap fits the Cloud silhouette. Choose Cloud or remove the wrap first.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 这件针织包覆仅适配原云团轮廓。请先选择云团或脱下包覆。
